characterList.description: A man with reddish-brown hair and a beard. He is wearing a red and black baseball cap, a black t-shirt that says "CLASSIC HORROR MOVIE MONSTERS", and a face mask with a picture of Michael Myers from the Halloween franchise.
characterList.name: Nate

characterList.description: A tall, animatronic skeleton with long black hair and a grey robe. It has glowing blue eyes and an open mouth, and it emits fog.
characterList.name: Hauntress

characterList.description: A tall, furry animatronic werewolf. It wears a green plaid shirt and gray pants, and its mouth is open in a fierce growl.
characterList.name: Wolfie

characterList.description: A small, animatronic character resembling the Trick 'r Treat doll, wearing a brown burlap sack mask, an orange jumpsuit, and holding a lollipop with a jack-o'-lantern on it.
characterList.name: Sam

characterList.description: A small, black animatronic spider that jumps.
characterList.name: Jumping Spider

characterList.description: An animatronic scarecrow with a plaid shirt, yellow glowing eyes, and a straw hat. It is attached to a wooden cross.
characterList.name: Scarecrow

characterList.description: A tall animatronic clown with green hair, a large red smile, sharp teeth, and wide-open eyes with spiraling pupils. It is dressed in a neon green and purple outfit with polka dots and stripes, and holds a large orange hammer.
characterList.name: Wacky

content_metadata.description: Join Nate on an exciting and humorous journey through the Spirit Halloween store in Salem, Massachusetts, as he interacts with animatronics, explores merchandise, and experiences spooky surprises.

qAndA.answer: Nate notices that the fog is blowing upwards, missing the girl animatronic’s face, and jokingly remarks that the Harvester is failing to capture her soul because of it.
